CREATE TABLE t(id INT PRIMARY KEY, a INT, nn INT NOT NULL, d INT DEFAULT 0, txt VARCHAR(30), n DECIMAL(8,2), dt DATE)
SELECT MIN(id),MAX(id),MIN(a),MIN(nn),MIN(d),COUNT(*),COUNT(a),SUM(id),AVG(id),MIN(txt),MIN(n),MIN(dt),MIN(id)+0,COUNT(*)+0 FROM t GROUP BY a
